name: Charred Tomato Salsa
method: Set a dry cast-iron pan or comal over high heat until very hot. Add the tomatoes cut-side down, the onion, the garlic, and the optional jalapeño. Leave them alone. Let them char — dark spots are the point. When the tomatoes have softened and the onion and garlic are charred in places, pull everything off. Squeeze the garlic from its skin. Rough-chop everything together or pulse briefly in a blender. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime. Leave it thick.

storage.note: Refrigerate. Gets better after an hour.

uses.label: Tacos
uses.context: Steak, shrimp, or beans. Let it be the sauce.

uses.label: Hot-pan dinner
uses.context: A spoonful beside the steak and charred corn.

uses.label: Black beans
uses.context: A few spoonfuls while the beans are still warm.

uses.label: Eggs
